mornington-peninsula-1.name: Point Nepean National Park
mornington-peninsula-1.bio: Park at the tip of the peninsula with Quarantine Station buildings, forts and tunnels, linked by a shuttle.

mornington-peninsula-2.name: Peninsula Hot Springs
mornington-peninsula-2.bio: Geothermal springs and day spa at Fingal, with over 70 bathing experiences, under 90 minutes from Melbourne.

mornington-peninsula-3.name: Cape Schanck Lighthouse
mornington-peninsula-3.bio: Active 1859 limestone lighthouse at the peninsula's southern tip, with guided tower climbs and a keeper's house museum.

mornington-peninsula-4.name: Arthurs Seat Summit
mornington-peninsula-4.bio: 305 m summit of Arthurs Seat in the state park, reached by road, with views over the bay.

mornington-peninsula-5.name: Fort Nepean
mornington-peninsula-5.bio: Fort at the peninsula's tip that guarded Port Phillip in both world wars, with tunnels between the gun emplacements.

mornington-peninsula-6.name: Mornington Peninsula National Park
mornington-peninsula-6.bio: Ocean beaches, Greens Bush and clifftop walks between Portsea and Flinders, with surf beaches at Gunnamatta and Rye.

mornington-peninsula-7.name: Sorrento
mornington-peninsula-7.bio: Seaside town between ocean and bay beaches, site of an 1803 convict settlement, with a ferry to Queenscliff.

mornington-peninsula-8.name: Portsea
mornington-peninsula-8.bio: Resort village at the tip of the peninsula, with the Portsea Hotel on the foreshore and the surf beach.

mornington-peninsula-9.name: Red Hill
mornington-peninsula-9.bio: Rural town of cool-climate wineries known for pinot noir, with farm-gate strawberries, cherries and apples in season.

mornington-peninsula-10.name: Two Bays Walking Trail
mornington-peninsula-10.bio: A 26 km walk from Dromana to Cape Schanck through Arthurs Seat and Greens Bush, done in two days or in sections.

mornington-peninsula-11.name: Coastal Walk (Mornington Peninsula)
mornington-peninsula-11.bio: Two-day walk along high clifftops and past ocean beaches in Mornington Peninsula National Park.

mornington-peninsula-12.name: Bushrangers Bay
mornington-peninsula-12.bio: Sandy beach ringed by basalt cliffs, reached by a 5.4 km return walk from Cape Schanck, with low-tide rockpools.

mornington-peninsula-13.name: Arthurs Seat State Park
mornington-peninsula-13.bio: Hill reserve whose 314 m summit looks to the Melbourne skyline on clear days, with walks and a Kings Falls circuit.

mornington-peninsula-14.name: Flinders Blowhole
mornington-peninsula-14.bio: Blowhole best seen at low tide from a headland lookout, with a steep stepped track down to the rockpools.

mornington-peninsula-15.name: Sorrento Ocean Beach
mornington-peninsula-15.bio: Long surf beach on the Bass Strait side of Sorrento, with patrolled sections but dangerous surf.

mornington-peninsula-16.name: Portsea Surf Beach
mornington-peninsula-16.bio: Ocean beach on the Bass Strait side of Portsea, patrolled in summer holidays, with surfing and rockpools.

mornington-peninsula-17.name: Gunnamatta Beach
mornington-peninsula-17.bio: Surf beach in Mornington Peninsula National Park that draws experienced surfers, patrolled in summer holidays.

mornington-peninsula-18.name: Coolart Wetlands and Homestead
mornington-peninsula-18.bio: Wetland reserve and homestead at Somers on Western Port Bay, with the homestead open Wednesdays and weekends.

mornington-peninsula-19.name: Mornington
mornington-peninsula-19.bio: Largest town on the peninsula's bay side, with a main street running down to the pier, cafes and a racecourse.

mornington-peninsula-20.name: McCrae Homestead
mornington-peninsula-20.bio: Home of artist Georgiana McCrae, who drew its plan herself in 1845, showing domestic life of the 1840s.

mornington-peninsula-21.name: The Briars
mornington-peninsula-21.bio: Early homestead holding Napoleon memorabilia, set in a wildlife sanctuary and gardens with free park entry.

mornington-peninsula-22.name: Dromana Beach
mornington-peninsula-22.bio: Bay beach at Dromana with brightly painted boat sheds lining the shore.

mornington-peninsula-23.name: Sorrento Front Beach
mornington-peninsula-23.bio: Calm bay beach on the Port Phillip side of Sorrento, beside the foreshore and the pier area.

mornington-peninsula-24.name: Rye Ocean Beach
mornington-peninsula-24.bio: Surf beach on Bass Strait with powerful waves and reef breaks, plus a long sandy shoreline to walk.

mornington-peninsula-25.name: Coppins Track
mornington-peninsula-25.bio: Clifftop track above Sorrento Ocean Beach, with stairs to a lookout platform, through coastal scrub to Diamond Bay.

mornington-peninsula-26.name: Mushroom Reef Marine Sanctuary
mornington-peninsula-26.bio: Marine sanctuary with a mushroom-shaped reef off Flinders, good for rockpools, snorkelling and diving, with no fishing.

mornington-peninsula-27.name: Alba Thermal Springs & Spa
mornington-peninsula-27.bio: Hot-springs spa in native bushland with outdoor geothermal rain and forest pools, plus private rooftop pools.

phillip-island-1.name: Penguin Parade
phillip-island-1.bio: Little penguins waddle home to their burrows at sunset every night, watched from boardwalks at Summerlands Beach.

phillip-island-2.name: The Nobbies
phillip-island-2.bio: Rocky south-west tip of Phillip Island with a boardwalk, coastal views and an education centre.

phillip-island-3.name: Koala Conservation Reserve
phillip-island-3.bio: Tree-top boardwalks over koalas in their natural habitat, plus bush trails with wallabies and echidnas.

phillip-island-4.name: Churchill Island
phillip-island-4.bio: Heritage farm island off Phillip Island with historic grounds, daily farming activities and free walking trails.

phillip-island-5.name: Cape Woolamai
phillip-island-5.bio: Phillip Island's highest point, with 4 to 8 km cliff walks above a surf beach and a Pinnacles return from the sand.

phillip-island-6.name: Phillip Island Grand Prix Circuit
phillip-island-6.bio: Racing circuit with a viewing mound showing most of the track and a display on the island's racing since 1928.

phillip-island-7.name: National Vietnam Veterans Museum
phillip-island-7.bio: Newhaven museum on Australia's role in the Vietnam War, with galleries on veterans' experiences and a Garden of Reflection.

phillip-island-8.name: Rhyll Inlet and Conservation Hill
phillip-island-8.bio: Mangrove and saltmarsh boardwalks on the north shore, plus a 500 m walk up an observation tower over Western Port.

phillip-island-9.name: Phillip Island Chocolate Factory
phillip-island-9.bio: Newhaven chocolate maker with a free shop and cafe and a ticketed interactive tour past a chocolate waterfall.

phillip-island-10.name: A Maze'N Things
phillip-island-10.bio: Family park with a giant 3D maze, 19-hole mini golf and a 10 m high ropes course, indoors and out.

french-island.name: French Island
french-island.bio: Western Port island reached by passenger ferry, with a national park holding Victoria's most significant koala population.

state-coal-mine.name: State Coal Mine
state-coal-mine.bio: Wonthaggi's former state coal mine, worked 1910 to 1968, with guided underground tours daily at 11.30am and 2pm.
